comments.text: In 2016, I was looking for places to visit far from mass tourism, and I ended up in Batanes for 5 days. comments.author: @MrCuriousEN
comments.text: What makes Batanes so fascinating is that resilience here is built into everyday life, not treated as something extraordinary. 🌊 The stone houses, farming methods, clothing and strong community ties all developed as practical answers to isolation and constant typhoons. It’s a powerful reminder that people don’t simply adapt to harsh environments, they create entire cultures around understanding and respecting them.
